review.summary: Round 3 reviews the TASK-069B branch after the documentation-only commit that responds to round 2. Since round 2 only AGENTS.md, DOMAIN.md and the TASK-069I task file changed. The AGENTS.md AI via MCP paragraph and the DOMAIN.md AI Domain status are re-wrapped with their wording unchanged, and no line in the edited paragraphs now exceeds the wrap width. TASK-069I's Testing section now lists the composed TASK-069B cores with a real unique-index conflict alongside the other PostgreSQL integration cases, consistent with its acceptance criteria. Application code and tests are unchanged since round 1; ruff, pyright and the full backend suite passed at the round 2 head with the same code, and the PostgreSQL integration tests were skipped without a database. The status text across AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, ADR-015, DOMAIN.md and AI.md is consistent. No new findings; the round 1 accepted risks recorded in round 2 remain for human review.
